entries.name: Bronze Furnace
entries.desc: Mei Qing's old bronze furnace. Three pills to a batch; it holds heat well enough.

entries.name: Jadeiron Furnace
entries.desc: Jadeiron walls a hand thick. Five pills to a batch, a steadier heat, and it strains a tenth of the impurities out.

entries.name: Cloudsteel Furnace
entries.desc: Cloudsteel etched with drifting clouds. Eight pills to a batch; a fifth of the impurities slide off its walls.

entries.name: Mistjade Furnace
entries.desc: A three-legged furnace of mistjade that hums over the fire. Ten pills to a batch, and it keeps almost a third of the impurities out.

entries.name: Nine-Dragon Cauldron
entries.desc: Nine bronze dragons coil round it and drink the heat. A named furnace: on any fire a perfect run can reach Grain, Halo and Soul. Eight pills to a batch; water pills come easier in it.

entries.name: Stormsteel Furnace
entries.desc: Blue-black stormsteel that drinks the lightning's heat. Ten pills to a batch.

entries.name: Sunsteel Furnace
entries.desc: Sunsteel set with desert glass that holds the fire's glow. Eleven pills to a batch.

entries.name: Driftsteel Furnace
entries.desc: Driftsteel walls lined with ground driftglass. Eleven pills to a batch, and little ash gets through.

entries.name: Lanternsteel Furnace
entries.desc: Cast from a lantern cage's metal; the fire in it never quite goes out. Twelve pills to a batch.

entries.name: Bone Collar
entries.desc: Boar hide and mole claws. +10% HP for the animal that wears it.

entries.name: Scale Talisman
entries.desc: Serpent and jade scales on a cord. +10% attack and +5% defence for the animal that wears it.

entries.name: Reed Saddle
entries.desc: Woven reed on boar hide. A mount wearing it carries you 10% faster.

entries.name: Ink-Warden's Brush
entries.desc: A Warden scribe's brush, its hairs set in black lacquer. Every technique written with it leaves a talisman on the foe.

entries.name: Starwrit Brush
entries.desc: Its tip was dipped in lantern ash. The characters it writes glow for a breath after.

entries.name: Warden's Hand-bell
entries.desc: A bronze bell rung on the Tidebreak walls at every change of watch. Its strikes ring out on both sides.

entries.name: Tidebreak Bell
entries.desc: Cast from a lantern cage that fell in the Breach. The Hollow does not like its note.

entries.name: Serpent-Tongue Jian
entries.desc: A rogue cultivator's jian, its blade forked at the tip. Whoever it belonged to, it is yours now.

entries.name: The Moonlit Blade
entries.unique: Awake spirit: +8% Qi attack; Moonlit Crescent every 8 hits

awake: The lake remembers the moon. So do I.
At last, a hand that listens.
kill: One less shadow on the water.
gift: Mist lotus... I dreamed of it for a hundred years.
devour: A small blade. It remembers little.
I take its edge into mine.
low_hp: Breathe. The water does not hurry.
Step back, and let me shine.
refuse: Your spirit is a puddle. I will not pour into it.

entries.name: The Sleeping Blade
entries.unique: Awake spirit: +10% crit damage; Waking Edge every 10 hits

awake: I slept in the dark long enough. Show me the light.
kill: The Abbot swung harder than that.
gift: Refined. Good. I can taste the fire in it.
devour: Crude steel. Still, it had a heart.
low_hp: Do not fall before I have had my fill.
Get up. We are not finished.
refuse: Soft hands. Soft soul. Put me down.

entries.name: Stone Drum Gauntlets
entries.desc: A monk of the old river temple beat these like a drum, and the mountain answered.

entries.name: Riverlight Jian
entries.desc: Forged in the shallows at dawn, so the saying goes, and quenched in the river's first light.

entries.name: Heron's Reach
entries.desc: Its bearer stood in the reeds so still that herons landed on the shaft.

entries.name: Reedwhisper Dagger
entries.desc: It makes no more sound than wind in the reeds. Its last owner was never heard coming.

entries.name: The Ferryman's Pole
entries.desc: A ferryman poled the dead across the river with it for three hundred years, and never once lost his footing.

entries.name: Mountainsplit Sabre
entries.desc: They say it split a hill in two. The hill, they add, had it coming.

entries.name: Seven Winds Fan
entries.desc: Six winds answer anyone who waves it. The seventh answers only a friend.

entries.name: Crane Mourning Flute
entries.desc: Carved from the wing bone of a crane that outlived its mate. Every tune it plays is a little sad.

entries.name: Dragonfly Bow
entries.desc: Light as a dragonfly's wing, and its arrows turn in the air the way a dragonfly does.

entries.name: Moonshadow Jian
entries.desc: A forge copy of the Moonlit Blade. It keeps six parts in ten of the original's gift, and no spirit.

entries.name: Drowsing Edge
entries.desc: A forge copy of the Sleeping Blade. It keeps six parts in ten of the original's gift, and no spirit.
